installed_scope: Initial installed lifecycle singleton; not general subject-to-account cardinality

account_id.mint: bot_core.uuid7; one captured internal UTC instant; integer uint48 milliseconds; no masking; CSPRNG 12+62; version7; RFC variant10

request.construction: Entirely internal: requalify exact VerifiedCHALogicalOperation and capture exact retained CHA snapshot; capture one UTC instant; mint unpublished candidate acct_; then build the request from that candidate and guarded snapshot. environment is derived from the exact nested LPPI binding; no caller request DTO accepted.
request.encoding: RFC8785/JCS UTF-8; exact fields; unknown fields reject
request.caller_inputs: Only exact VerifiedCHALogicalOperation; no IDs, timestamps, paths, authority or source tuples

fingerprint.preimage: Exact RFC8785/JCS UTF-8 bytes of all closed request fields, including candidate account_id and request_domain
fingerprint.explicit_unique_domain_separation: request_domain in the canonical fingerprinted preimage

canonical_binding: Exact canonical request bytes plus SHA256 integrity, including candidate account_id, environment/trust, action/product scope, reservation relationship and authenticated root-proof handoff expectation; exact ago, prvop, candidate acct and complete guarded CHA retained bytes; initial_binding_sha256 is SHA256 of JCS record without that field, detecting ordinary retained field corruption only, never authentication, authority, anti-rollback or freshness proof.
first_winner: Exact retry resumes retained winner; changed request/source or second ago rejects; no remint after durable binding; loader never mints
publication: Commit-before-response. In-memory mint before durable binding is unpublished. Failed replace/fsync rereads retained state and raises without capability; retry refences exact retained winner before issuance.

persistence.validation: Safe directory/path; symlink/reparse/hardlink reject; regular file only; bounded canonical records
persistence.posix: fsync temporary and published file plus directory
persistence.windows: Atomic MoveFileExW replacement with WRITE_THROUGH plus file flush

capability.name: VerifiedAccountGenesisInitialBinding
capability.authority: Private provenance registry; exact type; immutable opaque instance; public constructor/subclass/copy/deepcopy/object.__new__/JSON/retained row/string/DTO confer no authority
capability.consequential_use: Requalify upstream with require_verified_cha_logical_operation, reread fixed durable binding, compare exact bytes, ago/prvop/acct/request/source

protected_directory_precondition: Installed machine-protected authority directory; coherent privileged offline rewrite after restart is not cryptographically excluded

historical_request_reconciliation.statement: The historical exact schema was DESIGN_BLOCKED while its required semantic slots were already frozen. This child freezes the exact Stage 9 initial request schema, serialization and domain without removing any previously frozen semantic slot or rewriting historical statuses.
historical_request_reconciliation.domain_selection: Select historical fingerprint_contract.candidate_domain_literal as the exact request_domain; the historical exact domain was NOT_FROZEN.
historical_request_reconciliation.reservation_recovery: A_OPERATION_ID_BEFORE_OR_WITH_RESERVATION: exact operation/account relation is recovered by (pdsa_trust_domain, logical_operation_id); no separate reservation_id is created.
historical_request_reconciliation.upstream_source_binding: cha_state_sha256 covers the complete exact retained CHA snapshot; environment/trust and ago/prvop are derived from that same snapshot.
historical_request_reconciliation.retained_environment_binding: Exact canonical request bytes and complete retained CHA source bytes preserve environment/trust scope without adding duplicate retained fields.

root_proof_handoff.rule: A downstream root proof must satisfy the already bound authenticated handoff after INITIAL_BINDING and before PREPARED. No root_proof_id exists here; the future model requires authenticated CHA resolution and does not turn initial_binding_sha256 into authentication or authority.
